purpose: Keep the public product story, runtime behavior, proof boundary and external-reader clarity aligned.
central_claim: Founder Chief of Staff gives an AI agent the memory and discipline to keep founder work moving and apply earlier lessons before release.
required_distinctions: A context window is not operating memory.
A failure log is not learning.
Original sources remain authoritative; SQLite is a disposable search index.
Structural, synthetic and live evidence remain separate.
Narrative consistency and external-reader clarity are different release gates.

shipped_claims.claim: The release registers source ownership and explicit relationships.
The release builds a local disposable SQLite index and small context bundles.
The release selects relevant failure rules and evaluates work before release.
The release records typed outcomes without allowing policy to rewrite itself.
The release has fixed tests for retrieval, context limits, rule selection and candidate checks.
The public release blocks declared external surfaces that fail the writing contract.

prohibited_overclaims: General live reliability has been proven.
Every external reader will understand every artifact.
The system autonomously rewrites and improves its own policy.
The release includes vector retrieval or a graph database.
The release includes Gmail or Calendar ingestion.
The SQLite index is a source of truth.
release_rule: No public release until claim, reader, runtime, safety, link and visual gates all pass and the versioned report records the evidence.
